color-system.twistDescription: Copied verbatim — no twist applied. Agent 1 verified pageBackground luminance of #ffffff (255) qualifies as light register (>190).

type-system.twistDescription: Heading font weight shift (Twist C, intensity 3): h1 font-weight raised from 600 to 800 (+200), giving the display type greater optical mass. All three fonts (Playfair Display, Open Sans, Raleway) confirmed in known-google-fonts.md — CDN @import used.

motion-system.twistDescription: Duration scaling slower ×1.3 (Twist A, intensity 2): primary transition 1.9s → 2.47s; secondary 0.5s → 0.65s. Easing curves preserved. Creates a more languid, pressbound temporal quality.

grid-system.twistDescription: Container max-width tightened from 9999px to 1320px (Twist A, intensity 3 — editorial tighten). Responsive grid, column gaps, and container padding added to flesh out the sparse source system.

spacing-system.twistDescription: Hero padding emphasis ×1.5 (Twist C, intensity 3): paddingTop/Bottom raised from 128px to 192px. All other spacing values preserved.

interaction-states.twistDescription: Focus state enhancement added to all link and navigation states (Twist E, intensity 3): outlineWidth 2px, outlineStyle solid, outlineOffset 2px. Color values not changed.

nav-system.twistDescription: Letter spacing added to nav links: 0.08em (Twist D, intensity 3). Nav height raised to 56px, position changed to fixed, paddingInline 48px to support the spaced-out uppercase nav typography.

concept-summary.twistDescription: Material shift (Twist C, intensity 2): added one paragraph about the tactile/physical character of the typography — letterpress ink weight on heavy stock, uncoated paper grain. concept_by_video.md generated fresh with 3 video placements: hero-bg.mp4 (10s light diffusion), process-ambient.mp4 (5s macro material process), studio-interior.mp4 (8s slow push-in).

consistencyChecks.colorContrast: PASS — navText #000000 on transparent (→#ffffff), bodyText #000000 on pageBackground #ffffff
consistencyChecks.motionInteractionCoherence: PASS — hover at 0.3s vs media transitions at 2.47s are different purposes (interaction vs content reveal)
consistencyChecks.navFontAvailability: PASS — nav.json fontFamily: inherit, which resolves to font-secondary (Open Sans) present in typography.json
